The '''Tedonia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Khuiumin sector/Legends|Khuiumin sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Tedonian wine]].<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Tedonian wine]]|system=Tedonia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tedonia system was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
